**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The warranty package in § 19 sits at or above our preferred position:

- **§ 19.1** — professional and workmanlike performance by qualified personnel, to industry standards, plus a general material-conformity warranty for Services and Deliverables.
- **§ 19.2** — 90 days after the *later* of delivery or acceptance for Deliverables, and hosted Services conform *throughout the subscription term* (stronger than the preferred 12-month software period), plus an authority warranty.
- **§ 19.3** — no intentionally introduced malicious code, compliance with Applicable Law, no functionality diminution, and open-source protection.
- **§ 19.4** — re-perform/repair/replace at no charge, escalating to termination of the affected item and refund of Fees paid; expressly **non-exclusive** for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims.
- **§ 19.5** — disclaimer is limited to implied warranties and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranty (no walk-away "AS IS" risk).

§ 6.2 supplies an additional refund right after two failed correction cycles. Nothing here warrants a redline.
